name: Relaxr
author: Addicting Games
description: Relaxr is a chill game for chill people. Hey man, chill out. It's ok. Breath. Relax, just take a second. Look around. Look at the colors, look at the flares and the smoke. That's pretty cool, that's pretty chill. Drag your mouse around the screen, play with the controls on the right-hand side of the screen. See, you can make it look as cool as you want. Relaxr is chill like that. Relaxr is a game that understands sometimes you don't want to mow down an army of zombies, collect gold coins, chase other players or race for the finish line. Relaxr knows that sometimes you just wanna relax, look at some cool colors, some weird pattern, take a picture and share it with your friends. If you think you're done with games for a bit, maybe you just wanna chill out, look and some colors, think about your feelings or the future or whatever. That is cool. You're cool. Relaxr is cool. Relaxr gets it. Relaxr is here for it.
